'''Locris Syndicates''' was an arms and [[Armor/Legends|armor]] manufacturer that produced weapons such as [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], [[Micro-grenade launcher/Legends|micro-grenade launchers]], and [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launchers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
